name: libuv
readme_excerpt: ![libuv][libuvbanner] Overview libuv is a multi-platform support library with a focus on asynchronous I/O. It was primarily developed for use by [Node.js][], but it's also used by Luvit, Julia, uvloop, and others. Feature highlights Full-featured event loop backed by epoll, kqueue, IOCP, event ports.
